text: Driver event after resolve-context 0: that stage recorded that the shared 1962 calendar entry christ-the-king encoded the Communion as Ps 28:10 while the Missal (printed p. 698) prints Ps. 28, 10 et 11. With the maintainer's explicit authorization, the driver corrected that one range in src/sources/calendars/roman-1962/propers.yaml and regenerated src/web/data/structure/propers/roman-1962.json and roman-pre-1955.json (commit aa94dd3b4) before the research stage, so the research seal is taken over the corrected calendar and no stage reruns. The other shared-record defects resolve-context recorded (the Tract stored without its votive-after-Septuagesima condition, the missing paschal Alleluia, the stale F-series header note, the Ps 71:1 title numbering in the tracked Bibles, no commentator index row, no passage records for the orations and Preface) are left to their owners. The research brief states the correction as a fact to verify, not to trust.
